content.text: Git is the industry-standard distributed version control system used by virtually every software team. Understanding Git deeply — from its internal object model through advanced branching strategies and collaboration workflows — is essential for productive software development. This guide covers Git from fundamentals through advanced usage patterns used in professional environments.

items: What is Git — Core concepts, architecture, and the Git object model
Git Commands — Essential and advanced commands for daily workflows
Git Branching — Branching strategies, rebasing, and branch management
Local vs Remote Repository — Remote operations, fetch vs pull, and multi-remote setups
Merge Conflicts — Conflict resolution strategies and tools
Pull Requests — Code review workflows, PR best practices, and CI integration
.gitignore — Ignore patterns, global gitignore, and common templates
